records.name: Egypt
records.summary_text:
Egypt is a dangerous destination for trans visitors — with a directly documented study on the treatment of queer foreigners by Egyptian authorities ("Your Kind Is Not Welcome Here," Cairo 52, 12 incidents 2018-2022). Same-sex conduct is not explicitly criminalised, but authorities use "debauchery" and cybercrime laws (six months + fine for "violation of social and family values") to arrest and prosecute — and courts have moved from de facto to explicit criminalisation under the cybercrime law.
